featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is located in Vasai West at a walkable distance from the railway station. I think they've recently renovated this place, because there was a strong smell of paint when I'd visited. There are both, veg as well as nonveg items in the menu. The ambience was okay, not very lively. Even on a Sunday evening there was nobody here. The coffee was not as I expected it to be, but okay. the food items were okay. The maggi was good. The pricing needs to be worked on for the quantity offered. You can read books, play games like chess, UNO or Jenga blocks while having food. The table service was good, polite behaviour by the staff. It's a decent place to visit if you're looking to spend some time with your friends/colleagues having snacks and more.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I don’t even think this café deserves a single star.

When we first visited, we asked for stuffed garlic bread, but they said it wasn’t available. They suggested Cheese garlic bread instead, so we decided to order that along with cheese nachos.

The quantity of nachos was too little for the price, and they tasted exactly like a ₹10 packet of cheese chilli nachos — a big disappointment.

The worst was the garlic bread. We paid ₹200 for just two slices of plain white bread, topped with some garlic powder and cheese — that’s it. They said the food would come in 10 minutes, but it felt like we waited forever for that disappointing garlic bread.

Also, the restaurant had a lot of mosquitoes.

I would never recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Xavier Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this cafe today for the first time, The vibe was good... although there wasn't anybody else there.... We ordered a Pizza, Garlic bread, cold coffee and a KitKat shake. The pizza was delicious, really hot..served well. But, the KitKat shake was not properly made, the cocoa powder was not thoroughly mixed with the milk, and was clearly visible on the surface of the drink. Also, I would give a suggestion to please provide tissues or may be you can keep it on each table. The staff was good. Also, the girl who took the order was nice... She asked for the feedback at the end, which made me feel this place is open to accept suggestions from their customers. Anyways, I hope the management considers my suggestion and I hope to visit this place soon.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We will be glad to serve u the the best kit Shake u ever tasted this time tysm for your honest reveiw hoping to see u soon.

featured_reviews.name: VARSHA JOSHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Balwinders in Vasai is an excellent restaurant that offers a delicious menu with a wide variety of options. One of the standout dishes is the soya chaaps, which are soft, spicy, and tangy. The tandoori bharra chaap is also a must-try and is perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection.

For those who love spicy food, the ghost pepper chaap is a great choice. It's incredibly flavorful and packs a punch. The pahadi chaap is another unique and delicious option that is sure to satisfy any food lover's cravings.

The chaap rolls are also a great way to sample a variety of different flavors, and they're perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. The ingredients used in all of the dishes are of great quality, and the quantity is generous.

Overall, Balwinders is a great place to enjoy a delicious meal with friends and family. The soya chaaps, tandoori bharra chaap, ghost pepper chaap, and pahadi chaap are all must-tries. The chaap rolls are also a great option for those who want to sample a variety of flavors. The quality of the ingredients used is top-notch, and the quantity is generous.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Ohhh My God ! 

Varsha Ma'am,  we are really grateful to you for taking out time and reviewing the restaurant. 

Such reviews motivate us to to be non compromising on quality no matter how harsh the situation be. 

Just to your notice , in our weekly meeting we instruct all our staff that every dish served is a dish served to God and it brings immense happiness when our God (our customers) like our food. 

🙏A Big Thankyou from our side 🙏

featured_reviews.review_text: Staying in Mumbai, we hardly had any North Indian Street Food, that was until we found this hidden gem. They serve excellent Soya Chaap. The service was also very quick and even friendly, where the people behind counter actually explained us about what goes on in making chaap since we didn't had any idea about chaaps. Do visit this place.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

Dear Fakht Chinese Team,

I wanted to share my positive experience with a recent order we placed that included noodles, rice, and several starters.

First off, the delivery arrived right on time. We were also very pleased with the generous portion sizes. Even the half-sized dishes were substantial enough for a full meal for one person.

Moving on to the most important part – the taste and quality – everything was absolutely scrumptious. All the dishes in your Indian Chinese section were perfectly prepared, incredibly tasty, and very satisfying.

We also appreciated the inclusion of disposable cutlery. In the past, we've had issues with other restaurants not providing these items even when requested, so it was a pleasant surprise that Fakht Chinese included them without us having to ask.

Overall, the taste and your service were outstanding. Cheers to your team, and please keep up the excellent work!

featured_reviews.name: Vidyadheesh Upadhye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maharashtra, much like any other state in India, does have a rich culinary heritage. The symbols of its vegetarian cuisine have been Misal & Batata Wada (in the form of Wada Pav). There are a plethora of dishes but these are the most popular ones where vegetarian Maharashtrian cuisine is unknown.

My search for a decent plate of Misal has taken me places far & wide. This time it brought me to Santosh Misal Pav, located in the by-lanes of Vasai, a suburb of Mumbai.

This place is run by a family consisting of father, mother & son. They are very courteous & totally customer oriented. They constantly keep checking with each customer about their requirements to ensure that they have had their fill.

The menu is very simple & basic; Misal, Dahi Misal, Poha, Batata Wada, Idli & Buttermilk. While Poha, Idli & Batata Wada are available only for breakfast, Misal is available till closing hours i.e. 2.30 pm.

The Misal is made of moth beans (matki), farsan which includes chiwda, ghatia, peanuts, chopped onions & a spicy gravy. It is finally topped with fine & thin sev and served with 2 pieces of Pav. The gravy can be made more spicy, if required, by helping of a seperate spicy gravy.

The Misal was superb & tasted wonderful. It gave me a runny nose all throughout but I enjoyed eating it nonetheless in fact asked for an extra helping of the gravy. The Misal didn't give me any after effects of a spicy gravy like burning sensation or burps or the need have lots of water.

I had the buttermilk also which was really nice as well. They had added a crushed jeera masala which gave a nice flavour to it.

I am coming again whenever I'm in the vicinity. Are you?

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wasabi 2.0 offers a cozy dining experience with simple decor and a capacity of 16 seats across four tables, accompanied by sports on TV and phone-played music—though the frequent ringing can be distracting. Busy weekends may mean waits.

Open Bao - 5/5 (soft and delightful)

featured_reviews.name: Seon Almeida
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Wassabi for a quick bite, and I was impressed with the flavors and quality of the food. Here's a detailed review of my experience:

## Highlights
- *Lemon Coriander Soup*: The soup had a refreshing and zesty flavor profile, with a nice balance of lemon and coriander notes. However, the quantity was a bit limited.
- *Chicken Bao*: The Chicken Bao was a standout dish, with tender and juicy chicken filling wrapped in a soft and fluffy bao. The flavors were well-balanced, and the portion size was just right.

## Areas for Improvement
- *Soup Quantity*: As mentioned earlier, the quantity of the Lemon Coriander Soup was a bit limited. Perhaps considering a larger serving size or a more generous portion would enhance the overall value.

## Overall Experience
Despite the limited soup quantity, the food at Wassabi was delicious, and the service was prompt. The ambiance was modern and sleek, making it a great spot for a quick and satisfying meal. If you're a fan of Asian-inspired flavors and soft bao, Wassabi is definitely worth a visit.

## Recommendation
If you're looking for a quick and flavorful meal, Wassabi is a great option. Be sure to try the Chicken Bao, and don't hesitate to ask for more soup if you're hungry! Haha 😛

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Bunnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vasai anyways has very few options for sushi. Highly disappointed with my experience today. Order for a crispy chicken bao. The chicken was paper thin and coated heavily so all i could taste was deep fried batter. Ordered for prawn tempura sushi and usually there a layer of mayo but here there was just rice and over fried prawn that just made the taste dry and bitter. The chilly coriander momo was good. Service was really slow even though there were just 2 other customers that time.
I really hope they improve.

featured_reviews.name: sneha jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: "Wassabi 2.0 is a cozy spot serving up delicious Asian dishes. We tried their prawn tempura sushi and chicken garlic noodles, both of which were fantastic. The staff were friendly, and we felt the prices were fair. If you're in the mood for great Asian food, definitely give them a try!"
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your valuable feedback.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Wassabi 2.0, and I was very impressed! The pickled radish and wasabi were a delicious and unique addition to my meal, and the noodles and fried rice were cooked to perfection. The only downside was that parking was a bit of a challenge, since the restaurant is located on the main road. However, the delicious food made up for it. Overall, I would highly recommend Wassabi 2.0 to anyone looking for a delicious and authentic Asian dining experience.
